summary: You have booking, WhatsApp and a strong guarantee, but dead menus, conflicting claims and typos weaken a premium Harley Street brand.

findings.problem: The menu items Smile Gallery, Veneers, Cosmetic Dentistry, Dental Implants and About all point to #.
findings.cost: Patients looking for veneers click your main menu and go nowhere.
findings.fix: Working menu pages for every treatment.

findings.problem: The guarantee is described two ways, composite lasts six to eight years in one place and 5 years in the FAQ, and whitening and gum lifts are said to last forever.
findings.cost: Conflicting and unsupported claims erode trust.
findings.fix: One consistent, accurate set of claims.

findings.problem: Page claims 200+ Google reviews but shows about ten, some like Legend mate. The heading says London Smile Clinic and the rest says Marylebone Smile Clinic.
findings.cost: Thin reviews and a changing brand name weaken a premium clinic.
findings.fix: A full review wall and one brand name.

findings.problem: Typos such as offers veneers are made of and a list of a approved. A form shows the artifact smile Checkboxes Name.
findings.cost: Errors on a premium cosmetic site cost credibility.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and a clean form.

redesign: Clean menus, one clear guarantee and real results for each treatment.
A full review wall, named dentists and a simple booking form.
